# Leukocyte differential count — math appendix

<!-- GENERATED by video_studio/scripts/docs.mjs (same code as the video: video_studio/src/lib/differential.js) -->

**Illustrative count — not a patient result.** One invented 100-cell tally (`storyboard.json → data.sequence`, the order in which cells are met) and an invented WBC of 8 ×10⁹/L. Every number on screen (running tally, class counts, %, absolute counts) is computed from these in code; the real app frames were produced by tapping the same sequence in the app, so the app computed its own numbers from the same taps.

## 1. Definitions (as in the app, `differential_controller.dart → DiffRecord`)

- percent(c) = count(c) × 100 / total
- absolute(c) = count(c) / total × WBC (×10⁹/L; only when a WBC is entered)
- neutrophils (assessment) = segmented + band
- on screen: up to 1 decimal for %, up to 2 for ×10⁹/L, trailing zeros dropped (the app's `formatResult(maxDecimals)`)

## 6. What the numbers do NOT mean

- The tally is invented for teaching; it is not a patient result and is not presented as typical or normal.
- No reference interval is stated by the video. The app compares a COMPLETE count with the ranges on the laboratory's report form (editable in "Report reference ranges"; defaults are the app's sourced adult values) and says "This is not a diagnosis".
- 100 vs 200 cells, and how bands are reported, follow the laboratory SOP (app technique text).
